# Puffy UI

> React copy-paste components with a glass look, themed by four switches. Use Puffy parts and tokens before writing your own.

## Rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://puffyui.com/tokens/AGENTS.md): design rules for agents
- [Tokens CSS](https://puffyui.com/tokens/puffy-tokens.css)
- [Tokens JSON](https://puffyui.com/tokens/puffy-tokens.json)
- [Component manifest](https://puffyui.com/agent/components.json): every part, its props and install command
- [Design system](https://puffyui.com/system/)

## Parts
- [App](https://puffyui.com/r/app.json): App
- [Basics](https://puffyui.com/r/basics.json): GlassButtonGroup, GlassToggle, GlassToggleGroup, GlassNavMenu, GlassVideoPlayer, GlassCarousel, GlassSpinner, GlassKbd
- [Button](https://puffyui.com/r/button.json): GlassButton
- [Card](https://puffyui.com/r/card.json): GlassCard, GlassProgress
- [Combobox](https://puffyui.com/r/combobox.json): GlassCombobox
- [Controls](https://puffyui.com/r/controls.json): GlassSwitch, GlassCheckbox, GlassCheckboxGroup, GlassRadioGroup, GlassSlider
- [Dark](https://puffyui.com/r/dark.json): Dark
- [Display](https://puffyui.com/r/display.json): GlassBadge, GlassBanner, GlassAccordion, GlassTabs, GlassTable, GlassTooltip, GlassDots, GlassDialog
- [Dropdown](https://puffyui.com/r/dropdown.json): GlassDropdown
- [Icon](https://puffyui.com/r/icon.json): GlassIcon
- [Input](https://puffyui.com/r/input.json): GlassInput, GlassTextarea, GlassInputCopy
- [Menu](https://puffyui.com/r/menu.json): GlassList
- [Motion](https://puffyui.com/r/motion.json): Motion
- [Overlay](https://puffyui.com/r/overlay.json): GlassCommand, GlassDrawer, GlassToaster, GlassEmpty, GlassSkeleton, GlassDateRange, GlassStepper
- [Scene](https://puffyui.com/r/scene.json): GlassScene, GlassContent, GlassSurface, GlassBackdrop, LoopVideo
- [Select](https://puffyui.com/r/select.json): GlassSelect
- [Sound](https://puffyui.com/r/sound.json): GlassSounds
- [Surface](https://puffyui.com/r/surface.json): Surface
- [Theme Puffy](https://puffyui.com/r/theme-puffy.json): Theme Puffy
- [Theme Quiet](https://puffyui.com/r/theme-quiet.json): Theme Quiet
- [Everything](https://puffyui.com/r/all.json): Everything
- [Puffy tokens](https://puffyui.com/r/tokens.json): Puffy tokens
